value.name: Need-based tuition fee waiver (École Polytechnique Bachelor of Science)

scholarship_exists.quote: All other candidates, i.e. international, European and French students not entitled to the CROUS bursary, may benefit from need-based financial aid proposed directly by Ecole Polytechnique and by the Foundation of Ecole Polytechnique, in the form of: a tuition fee waiver granted by Ecole Polytechnique and/or an interest-free loan supported by Ecole Polytechnique Foundation.
scholarship_exists.notes: NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE, partial: same page, 'Any need-based financial aid that may be awarded will only partially cover fees or expenses.' and 'The total amount of need-based financial aid will depend on the family's resources.' Waivers are deducted from tuition; 'The exact number of tuition fee waivers is determined according to available funds.'; the 1,500 Euro annual administration fee is always due. Applied for after admission ('admitted candidates may apply for need-based financial aid'), decided by the Bachelor of Science Financial Aid Committee; no amount and no year printed. MERGE EFFECT: this replaces the base Excellence Scholarship fact (4,800 Euros per year for 3 years, honors admits only, international eligibility not stated on the page), because kb_build merges scholarship_exists as one answer. Reviewer decision: drop this file if the Excellence award should stay the KB's answer.

scholarship_international.quote: All other candidates, i.e. international, European and French students not entitled to the CROUS bursary, may benefit from need-based financial aid proposed directly by Ecole Polytechnique and by the Foundation of Ecole Polytechnique, in the form of: a tuition fee waiver granted by Ecole Polytechnique and/or an interest-free loan supported by Ecole Polytechnique Foundation.
scholarship_international.notes: The page names international students as eligible for the Ecole Polytechnique need-based tuition fee waiver (CROUS bursaries are for French and assimilated students). No citizenship restriction is printed.
